description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Princess's Resolve Mode], [Garnet Trance] and [Peridot Thunder] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Princess's Resolve Mode
description.text: Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Thundercloud Strike after using three Summoning abilities, removed after using three Summoning abilities

description.name: Garnet Trance
description.text: MAG and MND +30%, cast speed x2.00

description.name: Peridot Thunder
description.text: Grants [Garnet Trance] to the user after using three of Eidolon Justice or Song of Memories
